summary: Ares Capital Corp filed an 8-K reporting the issuance of $800 million aggregate principal amount of 5.550% notes due 2030 under a Sixth Supplemental Indenture. The notes mature January 15, 2030, pay semi-annual interest, and are direct unsecured obligations. Net proceeds will repay outstanding credit facility debt, with reborrowing for general corporate purposes. The transaction closed on May 11, 2026. This is a routine debt offering with no special-situation characteristics.
